bills.title: COVID-19 Vaccination Status (Prevention of Discrimination) Bill 2021

name: The same number of senators voted for and against the [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2021-12-02.68.1), which means it failed. ### Motion text > *At the end of the motion, add:* > > *"and, in respect of the [COVID-19 Vaccination Status (Prevention of Discrimination) Bill 2021](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=s1325), the bill be referred immediately to the Legal and Constitutional Affairs Legislation Committee for inquiry and report by 7 February 2022".*
